title_en: We are selling a 3+1 apartment in the Long Hill residence near TEG.
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in Long Hill We are selling a 3+1 apartment in the Long Hill residence near TEG. The apartment is part of a residential building in one of the best residences in the TEG area. It is located on the 2nd floor of a 3-story building. It is organized in a spacious living room and kitchen, a closed veranda with a glass ceiling, three bedrooms, three toilets, wardrobe, laundry, two parking spaces. The interior has been invested in recent years with an architect and the best brands. Wooden floors, thermal windows, DAIKIN air conditioning system, incaso toilets and underfloor heating, ethanol fireplace.... Has ownership certificate. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
